newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada to cooperate with French National Assembly.
newsitem.headline: Canada to cooperate with French National Assembly.

text.p: Canada will cooperate with the new government elected in the French elections, a Foreign Affairs Department official told Reuters late on Sunday.
"We will work with the deputies elected by the French," Foreign Affairs spokesperson Sanjeev Chowdhury told Reuters.
Canada has always had a very good relationship and the election results will not affect that, said the spokesman.
"We have had an excellent relationship between Canada and France and we have confidence this relationship between the two countries will continue," said Chowdhury.
